about.title: About me
about.admin: I am a professional dedicated to efficient management, firmly convinced that what is not measured cannot be controlled. Continuous improvement is a core pillar: I plan, analyze and control administrative processes with initiative and critical thinking. I am motivated to standardize workflows, audit processes and deliver solutions that generate measurable value.
about.tech: I am deeply curious about how things work and how technology transforms processes. Learning is a continuous journey: I research, analyze and self-train to take on challenges with initiative and critical thinking. I am motivated to discover solutions, optimize tasks and contribute ideas that generate real value in every project I join.

why.title: Business vision + technical capability
why.desc: I translate business needs into tangible technological solutions.

why.title: Operational cost reduction
why.desc: I automate workflows and eliminate rework that consumes time and money.

why.title: Continuous improvement
why.desc: I design KPIs, audits and dashboards for data-driven decisions.

items.role: Purchasing & Administrative Operations Assistant · Financial Support
admin: Comprehensive management of electronic invoicing, purchase orders and strategic catering requisitions.
Inventory control, delivery auditing and logistical support for procurement.
Treasury management, petty cash oversight and execution of corporate bank reconciliations.
Led optimization of administrative and accounting processes, reducing rework and streamlining decisions.
Designed and implemented internal workflow improvements via task standardization and management tools.
Structured workflows for processing ERP accounting data, consolidating reports and BI dashboards for financial audits.
tech: Built automated ETL workflows with Python for accounting data extracted from the ERP.
Data cleaning and structuring with Python (Pandas) for financial analysis.
Interactive visualization and decision-making with Power BI (DAX, Power Query).
Identified improvement opportunities through digitalization and task standardization.
Strategic vision for the use of technology in administrative and accounting processes.
Cross-functional technological and financial support to ensure operational continuity.

items.role: Accounting Assistant & Administrative Technology Support Intern
admin: Management of electronic invoicing, purchase-order issuance and strict document control.
Executed disbursements, petty cash, cash counts and treasury activities with internal controls that improved traceability and transparency.
Comprehensive support to operational and administrative areas (reception, school store) for service continuity.
tech: Accurate recording and document traceability in digitalized accounting processes.
Administrative technology support: adoption and use of office and management tools.
Logistical coordination and information integration across areas.

services.title: Services
services.lead: I combine financial judgment with technical execution to deliver solutions that streamline processes and decisions.

items.title: End-to-end procurement & vendor management
items.desc: Full purchasing cycle: e-invoicing, purchase orders, requisitions and logistics control of inventories.

items.title: Treasury & reconciliations
items.desc: Rigorous cash-flow operations: disbursements, petty cash control, cash counts and corporate bank reconciliations.

items.title: Audit & structured document management
items.desc: Organization and control of accounting and administrative supports to ensure full traceability and audit compliance.

items.title: Process standardization & KPI tracking
items.desc: Redesign of internal flows to cut manual work and rework, with definition and monitoring of key performance indicators.

items.title: Cross-functional administrative support
items.desc: Advanced Excel for financial consolidation, operational continuity and transversal support across teams.

items.title: ETL pipelines & data processing
items.desc: Automated pipelines with Python and Pandas for extraction, cleansing (EDA) and structuring of large financial and operational datasets.

items.title: Business Intelligence & visual analytics
items.desc: Relational data modeling (SQL, DAX, Power Query) and interactive dashboards in Power BI and Tableau for managerial decisions.

items.title: ERP administration & integration (Oracle NetSuite)
items.desc: Implementation, master-data quality control and automated extraction (XML, JSON) from the ERP for digital transformation.

items.title: Logical solution design & data architecture
items.desc: Functional requirements gathering and system integration design using Zapier, APIs and connectors.

items.title: Analytical methodologies (CRISP-DM)
items.desc: Structured methodologies applied to data analytics projects so tech solutions solve real operational problems.

items.quote: Mariangel stands out for her ability to integrate technology into administrative, accounting and operational processes, delivering solutions that save time, reduce rework and strengthen decision-making. Her hands-on experience in automation, ERP (NetSuite), data analysis and digitalization shows a valuable blend of technical judgment and strategic vision.
